description: Manual: Renovate lists what could be updated on the Dependency Dashboard issue and opens no branch and no pull request until a box is ticked there. Nothing is merged automatically. The updates are taken in one round a week, by hand

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A fix for a GitHub security alert waits for a tick on the dashboard like every other update; without this line Renovate opens such a pull request at once, whatever the setting above says

packageRules.description: One pull request, and so one run of the macOS CI, for every minor and patch update of a dependency at 1.0 or later
Below 1.0 only patch updates join that pull request. Cargo treats 0.x to 0.y as a breaking change, so each of those gets a pull request of its own, as a major update does

uniffi generates the Swift bindings committed under macos-app/DedupdClient/Generated, and CI does not build the app. Every uniffi update therefore gets a pull request of its own, with a note on what to run before it is merged
prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `just app-bindings` and `just app-check` on this branch, and commit what changed under `macos-app/DedupdClient/Generated/`.
